Owner requirements

Requirements for listing a van in India. Rules vary by state — our team confirms during review.

Identity (KYC)

  • Aadhaar (via DigiLocker or masked copy)
  • PAN card
  • Live selfie for face match

Vehicle documents

  • Registration Certificate (RC) (expiry tracked)
  • Rent-a-Motor-Cab / self-drive rental licence (expiry tracked)
  • Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate (expiry tracked)
  • Fitness certificate (commercial vehicle) (expiry tracked)
  • All India Tourist Permit (for interstate trips) — if applicable (expiry tracked)
  • Caravan registration with State Tourism (if applicable) — if applicable (expiry tracked)

Insurance

  • Commercial comprehensive insurance (self-drive rental cover)

Safety inspection checklist

  • Tyres (tread depth ≥ 1.6 mm) and spare wheel
  • Brakes, steering and suspension
  • Headlights, indicators and brake lights
  • Seat belts for every seating position
  • LPG cylinder, regulator and hose certified / leak tested
  • Fire extinguisher (in date) and smoke / CO detector
  • First-aid kit and emergency warning triangle
  • 12V / 230V electrics, inverter and wiring safe
  • Fresh / grey water tanks clean and leak-free
  • GPS tracker and roadside-assistance number on board

Payouts

Bank account with IFSC code, verified by a ₹1 penny-drop. Payouts are sent 24 hours after the trip starts.
